tha-ap101:1.1: Veyyāvaccaka.] Vipassissa bhagavato mahāpūgagaṇo ahu / veyyāvaccakaro āsiṃ sabbakiccesu vyāvaṭo. // //
tha-ap101:2.1: Deyyadhammo ca me n' atthi sugatassa mahesino / avandiṃ satthuno pāde vippasannena cetasā. // //
tha-ap101:3.1: Ekanavut' ito kappe veyyāvaccaṃ akās' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi veyyāvaccass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap101:4.1: Ito aṭṭhamake kappe rājā āsiṃ Sucintito / sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahābalo. // //
tha-ap101:5.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap101:6.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Veyyāvaccakaro thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
